title: 15.21. Hetuduka, Ajjhattārammaṇattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuṁ ajjhattārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu naajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Sabbattha tīṇi.)
Hetuṁ bahiddhārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu nabahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
